sort-lines.how: Reorders lines alphabetically in ascending or descending order while keeping the individual line contents intact.
sort-lines.tryThis: Paste three names in the wrong order, then compare ascending and descending results.
sort-lines.watch: Sorting changes row order; save the original if positional relationships matter.

reverse-text.how: Reverses the order of text characters for inspection or playful transformation.
reverse-text.tryThis: Enter a short phrase, then reverse the result again to compare with the original.
reverse-text.watch: Unicode grapheme clusters can include several code points and may not reverse as a single visual character.

remove-extra-spaces.how: Normalizes repeated spacing to make copied text easier to read and reuse.
remove-extra-spaces.tryThis: Paste a sentence with repeated spaces and compare the corrected output.
remove-extra-spaces.watch: Review whitespace in code, indentation or fixed-width formats before replacing it.

find-and-replace.how: Finds text occurrences and applies replacement text to the editable result.
find-and-replace.tryThis: Replace an outdated product name in a short sample before working on a longer document.
find-and-replace.watch: Preview matches carefully when case sensitivity or repeated substrings matter.

text-compare.how: Compares two texts line by line, identifying unchanged, added and removed sections.
text-compare.tryThis: Paste two versions of a paragraph and review the highlighted line changes.
text-compare.watch: Large documents are limited to protect browser responsiveness; compare smaller sections if needed.

slug-generator.how: Converts a phrase into a lowercase, URL-friendly slug.
slug-generator.tryThis: Try a title with spaces and punctuation, then check the generated path segment.
slug-generator.watch: Slugs may lose accents or punctuation; ensure uniqueness before publishing a URL.

json-minifier.how: Removes unnecessary JSON whitespace without changing its parsed structure.
json-minifier.tryThis: Paste formatted JSON and compare the compact result with the original.
json-minifier.watch: Whitespace inside string values is data and should remain unchanged.

json-escape.how: Escapes a text value for inclusion inside a JSON string.
json-escape.tryThis: Enter text with quotes and line breaks, then inspect the escaped result.
json-escape.watch: Escape sequences are not the same as URL encoding or HTML entity escaping.

json-unescape.how: Decodes JSON string escape sequences such as newline, tab and Unicode escapes.
json-unescape.tryThis: Try a quoted JSON string containing \n or \u00e9 and inspect the decoded result.
json-unescape.watch: Malformed JSON escapes must be corrected rather than silently ignored.

json-to-csv.how: Converts an array of JSON objects into a delimited table with a header row.
json-to-csv.tryThis: Use two objects with overlapping keys, then inspect CSV headers and empty cells.
json-to-csv.watch: Nested objects become serialized cell content, not additional spreadsheet columns.

json-to-xml.how: Serializes JSON objects or arrays as a hierarchical XML representation.
json-to-xml.tryThis: Try an object containing a list, then inspect the generated nested XML elements.
json-to-xml.watch: XML names must be valid; transformed property names may not match the original JSON keys.

json-to-yaml.how: Renders JSON data as YAML while preserving scalar values and nested collections where possible.
json-to-yaml.tryThis: Convert a small JSON settings object and examine indentation and arrays.
json-to-yaml.watch: Review quotation and special characters when reusing YAML in configuration files.

url-encode.how: Encodes text into a URL component where reserved characters need escaping.
url-encode.tryThis: Enter a phrase containing spaces and an ampersand to see the escaped representation.
url-encode.watch: Encoding a complete URL as one component differs from encoding its individual parameters.

url-decode.how: Decodes percent-encoded URL component text into readable characters.
url-decode.tryThis: Decode a short string containing %20 and inspect the resulting spaces.
url-decode.watch: Malformed percent sequences can fail; plus signs may be interpreted as spaces in form-style content.

html-encode.how: Replaces special HTML characters with safe entity forms for textual display.
html-encode.tryThis: Encode an angle-bracket tag and compare its text rendering to the original.
html-encode.watch: Encoding is context-sensitive; do not use HTML escaping as a substitute for URL or JavaScript escaping.

html-decode.how: Converts HTML entity references back to their corresponding text characters.
html-decode.tryThis: Decode &amp; and inspect the resulting ampersand entity.
html-decode.watch: Decoded text can contain markup characters; treat it as data rather than trusted HTML.

xml-formatter.how: Parses and reserializes XML for easier visual inspection.
xml-formatter.tryThis: Paste a compact XML document and review the formatted output.
xml-formatter.watch: A serializer may change spacing or empty-element notation; verify compatibility with downstream systems.

xml-validator.how: Checks whether XML text is syntactically parseable and reports parser errors.
xml-validator.tryThis: Test a document with an unclosed element and inspect the error feedback.
xml-validator.watch: A well-formed XML document is not necessarily valid against a schema or DTD.

yaml-validator.how: Checks YAML parsing, including malformed indentation or duplicated mapping keys.
yaml-validator.tryThis: Try a small YAML mapping, then intentionally repeat a key.
yaml-validator.watch: Successful syntax validation does not prove the settings are accepted by a particular application.

jwt-decoder.how: Decodes the header and payload segments of a JSON Web Token for inspection.
jwt-decoder.tryThis: Inspect a sample token header and compare the declared algorithm with its payload claims.
jwt-decoder.watch: Decoding a JWT does not verify its cryptographic signature or make its claims trustworthy.

unix-timestamp-converter.how: Converts Unix time values and date strings into human-readable time representations.
unix-timestamp-converter.tryThis: Compare a known timestamp in seconds and the equivalent value in milliseconds.
unix-timestamp-converter.watch: Check your input units and time zone before comparing displayed local times.

passphrase-generator.how: Combines randomly selected words into a memorable secret phrase.
passphrase-generator.tryThis: Generate a ten-word phrase and regenerate to see how the combination changes.
passphrase-generator.watch: The safety of a phrase depends on independent random selection and protecting the generated secret.

random-string-generator.how: Generates random strings using selected character sets and length settings.
random-string-generator.tryThis: Generate several values with letters, digits and punctuation enabled.
random-string-generator.watch: Avoid assumptions about downstream password rules; choose an accepted length and alphabet.

secure-token-generator.how: Generates cryptographically random bytes encoded as hex or URL-safe Base64.
secure-token-generator.tryThis: Generate a token in both formats and compare character lengths.
secure-token-generator.watch: A token is sensitive; store it securely and do not paste it into logs or analytics.

password-strength-checker.how: Estimates password strength from length and character patterns in the browser.
password-strength-checker.tryThis: Compare a short predictable password with a longer randomized one.
password-strength-checker.watch: This is a basic heuristic, not a guarantee that a password has never leaked.

sha256-hash-generator.how: Computes a SHA-256 digest for supplied text using Web Crypto.
sha256-hash-generator.tryThis: Hash the same text twice to confirm the digest remains the same.
sha256-hash-generator.watch: SHA-256 is a general-purpose hash, not a salted password-storage algorithm.

sha512-hash-generator.how: Computes a SHA-512 digest from text and displays its hexadecimal value.
sha512-hash-generator.tryThis: Change one character in a sample string and compare the resulting digest.
sha512-hash-generator.watch: Hashing is not encryption and cannot be reversed to recover the input.

hmac-generator.how: Creates an HMAC signature of a message using a secret key and a selected hash.
hmac-generator.tryThis: Sign a sample message, change one character and regenerate the signature.
hmac-generator.watch: The same key and exact bytes must be used when verifying a signature elsewhere.

basic-auth-generator.how: Creates an HTTP Basic Authorization header from a username and password.
basic-auth-generator.tryThis: Enter a test username and password, then inspect the Base64-encoded header.
basic-auth-generator.watch: Basic Auth encodes credentials but does not encrypt them; use HTTPS and avoid real credentials on shared devices.

hash-compare.how: Compares two hash values, with an option to ignore letter case.
hash-compare.tryThis: Paste two equal hexadecimal digests and then change one character.
hash-compare.watch: Comparing strings alone does not establish the origin or authenticity of either digest.

qr-text-generator.how: Encodes plain text as a scannable QR payload without navigating to a website.
qr-text-generator.tryThis: Try a short message and scan the result with a second device.
qr-text-generator.watch: Very long text increases QR density and may reduce practical scanning reliability.

qr-wifi-generator.how: Encodes Wi-Fi network name, security type and password into the Wi-Fi QR format.
qr-wifi-generator.tryThis: Generate a QR code for a test network with punctuation in its SSID.
qr-wifi-generator.watch: Treat exported QR images as secrets if they contain a real Wi-Fi password.

qr-email-generator.how: Encodes an email address, subject and message as a mailto link.
qr-email-generator.tryThis: Try an address and a subject containing spaces, then inspect the opened mail client.
qr-email-generator.watch: Mail applications vary in how they handle prefilled content.

qr-phone-generator.how: Encodes a telephone link that compatible phone scanners can open.
qr-phone-generator.tryThis: Try an international test number including its country calling code.
qr-phone-generator.watch: Scanner applications vary; use an actual valid number when publishing.

qr-sms-generator.how: Encodes a phone number and an SMS text in a mobile-friendly payload.
qr-sms-generator.tryThis: Try a short test message and verify how the phone messaging app opens it.
qr-sms-generator.watch: SMS QR support varies between scanner and messaging applications.

qr-whatsapp-generator.how: Creates a WhatsApp chat URL with an optional prefilled message.
qr-whatsapp-generator.tryThis: Try an international number and a short message containing spaces.
qr-whatsapp-generator.watch: The destination number must use international digits without a leading local trunk prefix.

qr-vcard-generator.how: Encodes contact details in vCard 3.0 format for address-book import.
qr-vcard-generator.tryThis: Try a name, organization and telephone number, then test importing the contact.
qr-vcard-generator.watch: Special characters and contact-app field support should be tested before mass printing.

qr-location-generator.how: Encodes latitude and longitude in a geo URI for a map-compatible scanner.
qr-location-generator.tryThis: Try coordinates 0,0, then replace them with the intended location.
qr-location-generator.watch: Coordinates must be within valid geographic ranges; receiver support can vary.

qr-event-generator.how: Encodes a calendar event with title, local start/end times and optional location.
qr-event-generator.tryThis: Create a short event with an end time after its start and test adding it to a calendar.
qr-event-generator.watch: Floating local date-times follow the scanning device's local time zone.

percentage-change-calculator.how: Measures relative change between an original number and a new number.
percentage-change-calculator.tryThis: Compare a value before and after a price adjustment.
percentage-change-calculator.watch: An original value of zero has no defined percentage change in this calculation.

tip-calculator.how: Calculates the total bill, tip amount and share per person.
tip-calculator.tryThis: Enter a bill, tip percentage and number of diners.
tip-calculator.watch: The person count must be a positive whole number; local tax or service charges may change the bill.

simple-interest-calculator.how: Computes linear interest on a principal over a period of years.
simple-interest-calculator.tryThis: Try one year and then two years while keeping the rate fixed.
simple-interest-calculator.watch: Simple interest does not compound unless the terms explicitly say so.

compound-interest-calculator.how: Models growth when interest is added a specified number of times per year.
compound-interest-calculator.tryThis: Compare annual and monthly compounding for the same principal and rate.
compound-interest-calculator.watch: Actual returns may be affected by fees, taxes, contribution timing and variable rates.

date-difference-calculator.how: Counts whole calendar days between two selected dates.
date-difference-calculator.tryThis: Compare dates on opposite sides of a daylight-saving clock change.
date-difference-calculator.watch: The result counts calendar days, not elapsed clock hours.

time-duration-calculator.how: Calculates the interval between two clock times, including a period that passes midnight.
time-duration-calculator.tryThis: Enter 23:50 as the start and 00:20 as the end.
time-duration-calculator.watch: Two equal times are treated as a zero-length interval rather than a full day.

average-calculator.how: Computes mean, minimum, maximum and count from a list of numbers.
average-calculator.tryThis: Enter three comma-separated values and compare the displayed average and sum.
average-calculator.watch: Unexpected words or nonfinite values are rejected rather than silently omitted.

area-converter.how: Converts surface area between square metres, hectares, acres and other units.
area-converter.tryThis: Compare one hectare with its equivalent square metres.
area-converter.watch: Area uses squared units; a linear metre cannot be substituted for a square metre.

volume-converter.how: Converts capacity among litres, millilitres, cubic metres and US customary volume units.
volume-converter.tryThis: Compare a US gallon with litres using the labelled units.
volume-converter.watch: US and imperial gallons are different; check which standard your source uses.

speed-converter.how: Converts speed between metres per second, kilometres per hour, miles per hour and more.
speed-converter.tryThis: Enter a highway speed in km/h and compare it with mph.
speed-converter.watch: Displayed decimals are rounded; use consistent units for further calculations.

time-converter.how: Converts durations across seconds, minutes, hours, days and weeks.
time-converter.watch: A 24-hour day is a duration assumption and does not represent every civil calendar day.

data-storage-converter.how: Compares decimal storage units and binary storage units such as MB versus MiB.
data-storage-converter.tryThis: Convert one GiB into MB to see the difference.
data-storage-converter.watch: KB/MB and KiB/MiB use different unit bases; check device and software conventions.

pressure-converter.how: Converts pressure among pascals, kilopascals, bar, psi and atmospheres.
pressure-converter.tryThis: Compare a tyre pressure in psi with kilopascals.
pressure-converter.watch: Do not use rounded values for precision-sensitive pressure specifications.

energy-converter.how: Converts joules, calories, watt-hours and kilowatt-hours.
energy-converter.watch: A food calorie is commonly a kilocalorie, not the small-calorie unit labelled cal.

power-converter.how: Converts power values among watts, kilowatts, megawatts and horsepower.
power-converter.tryThis: Compare one mechanical horsepower with watts.
power-converter.watch: Different horsepower definitions exist; use the unit definition matching your context.

angle-converter.how: Converts angles between degrees, radians, turns and gradians.
angle-converter.watch: Angles are not lengths; calculations using trigonometric functions often expect radians.

frequency-converter.how: Converts frequency values between hertz and metric multiples.
frequency-converter.watch: A frequency conversion does not estimate bandwidth or data throughput.

force-converter.how: Converts force measurements between newtons, pound-force and kilogram-force.
force-converter.watch: Mass and force are different quantities; kilogram-force is not a kilogram of mass.

torque-converter.how: Converts moments of force across newton-metres and customary torque units.
torque-converter.tryThis: Convert a tightening specification from lb-ft to N·m.
torque-converter.watch: Torque is not energy even though some unit symbols may look similar.

density-converter.how: Converts mass per volume across common metric and imperial density units.
density-converter.watch: Density varies with substance and temperature; a unit converter does not determine material properties.

acceleration-converter.how: Converts acceleration across m/s², g-force, ft/s² and Gal.
acceleration-converter.tryThis: Convert standard gravity into metres per second squared.
acceleration-converter.watch: The standard g-force definition is a conventional reference, not the local gravity measurement.

fuel-economy-converter.how: Converts between L/100 km, US/UK mpg and km per litre.
fuel-economy-converter.tryThis: Compare a car's US mpg value with litres per 100 kilometres.
fuel-economy-converter.watch: Fuel economy inversely relates to fuel consumption; zero or negative values are invalid.

data-transfer-rate-converter.how: Converts network transfer rates from bits per second to bytes per second and metric multiples.
data-transfer-rate-converter.tryThis: Compare 100 Mbps with megabytes per second.
data-transfer-rate-converter.watch: A lowercase b means bits, uppercase B means bytes; protocol overhead changes actual throughput.

cooking-volume-converter.how: Converts kitchen volume measures including millilitres, teaspoons and cups.
cooking-volume-converter.tryThis: Convert one US cup into millilitres.
cooking-volume-converter.watch: Cup and spoon sizes vary between countries and recipes; this tool uses US definitions.

line-counter.how: Counts total, nonempty and empty lines in pasted text.
line-counter.tryThis: Paste a paragraph containing blank lines and compare total versus nonempty counts.
line-counter.watch: A trailing line break may produce an extra empty line, depending on the counting convention.

sentence-counter.how: Estimates sentence count using sentence-ending punctuation.
sentence-counter.tryThis: Try a passage with periods, question marks and exclamation marks.
sentence-counter.watch: Abbreviations and unusual punctuation can make automatic sentence counts approximate.

paragraph-counter.how: Counts text blocks separated by blank lines and reports their lengths.
paragraph-counter.tryThis: Paste text containing two blocks separated by an empty line.
paragraph-counter.watch: Single line breaks inside a paragraph are not necessarily paragraph breaks.

text-to-list.how: Splits comma-, semicolon- or tab-separated text into lines.
text-to-list.tryThis: Enter three comma-separated entries and review the resulting vertical list.
text-to-list.watch: Quoted CSV fields containing commas need a dedicated CSV parser.

list-to-text.how: Joins individual lines into one sequence with a chosen separator.
list-to-text.tryThis: Paste three names on separate lines and join them with commas.
list-to-text.watch: Empty lines may be excluded from the joined result.

remove-empty-lines.how: Removes blank lines and can add a prefix and suffix to the remaining lines.
remove-empty-lines.tryThis: Paste an alternating list of text and empty rows, then add a prefix.
remove-empty-lines.watch: Whitespace-only lines may be treated as empty; review intentional formatting.

add-line-numbers.how: Prefixes lines with sequential numbers from a chosen starting number.
add-line-numbers.tryThis: Enter several lines and start numbering from 1.
add-line-numbers.watch: Number prefixes become part of copied text and may need removing later.

strip-html-tags.how: Parses HTML and extracts its text content without tags.
strip-html-tags.tryThis: Paste a paragraph with nested formatting tags and review the plain text.
strip-html-tags.watch: Scripts, CSS and some layout semantics may not appear in extracted text.

text-repeater.how: Repeats a text sample with a selected separator and repeat count.
text-repeater.tryThis: Repeat a short phrase five times with newlines between copies.
text-repeater.watch: Repeating very large text can produce unexpectedly large output.

whitespace-visualizer.how: Replaces invisible whitespace with visible markers for debugging.
whitespace-visualizer.tryThis: Paste tabs, spaces and line breaks to see each kind of spacing.
whitespace-visualizer.watch: Markers are visual aids, not the original raw characters.

ratio-calculator.how: Simplifies an integer ratio by its greatest common divisor.
ratio-calculator.tryThis: Enter 12 and 18 to obtain the simplified relationship.
ratio-calculator.watch: Decimal inputs are not supported in the exact ratio simplification.

proportion-calculator.how: Solves the missing fourth term in a relationship of proportional quantities.
proportion-calculator.tryThis: Enter three related values to calculate the fourth.
proportion-calculator.watch: A zero denominator or zero scaling quantity can make the relationship undefined.

fraction-calculator.how: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides exact integer fractions.
fraction-calculator.tryThis: Add one half and one third, then inspect both fraction and decimal forms.
fraction-calculator.watch: Denominators cannot be zero; dividing by a zero numerator is undefined.

gcd-lcm-calculator.how: Calculates greatest common divisor and least common multiple of integers.
gcd-lcm-calculator.tryThis: Enter 12, 18 and 30 to compare their common divisor and common multiple.
gcd-lcm-calculator.watch: Very large integer combinations may exceed JavaScript's exact safe range.

pace-calculator.how: Computes running pace and speed from distance and total elapsed time.
pace-calculator.tryThis: Enter 5 km in 30 minutes to compare min/km and km/h.
pace-calculator.watch: Hours and minutes must describe the elapsed duration; terrain and stops are not modeled.

unit-price-calculator.how: Compares the cost per unit for two differently priced packages.
unit-price-calculator.tryThis: Enter two prices with package quantities to see the cheaper per-unit price.
unit-price-calculator.watch: Both quantities must use compatible units and be greater than zero.

profit-margin-calculator.how: Separates profit from revenue and calculates margin and markup percentages.
profit-margin-calculator.tryThis: Compare a selling price of 100 with a cost of 60.
profit-margin-calculator.watch: Margin divides by selling price; markup divides by cost.

markup-calculator.how: Applies a markup percentage to cost and shows the resulting selling price.
markup-calculator.tryThis: Start with cost 60 and markup 50% to see the difference from margin.
markup-calculator.watch: A percentage markup is not the same as the percentage profit margin.

add-blank-lines-between-text.how: Inserts additional empty lines between existing text lines.
add-blank-lines-between-text.tryThis: Paste a short list and add blank lines for readability.
add-blank-lines-between-text.watch: Added newlines change character counts and downstream parsing.

add-prefix-suffix-to-lines.how: Adds a fixed prefix or suffix to each line independently.
add-prefix-suffix-to-lines.tryThis: Add a dash or quotation mark to every entry in a list.
add-prefix-suffix-to-lines.watch: The transformation affects each line even if the line contains punctuation.

trim-each-line.how: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from every line.
trim-each-line.tryThis: Paste indented lines and compare their trimmed copies.
trim-each-line.watch: Trimming can break code indentation or intentional fixed-width formatting.

quote-each-line.how: Wraps each line in a selected quotation format.
quote-each-line.tryThis: Convert a list of plain values into quoted items.
quote-each-line.watch: Existing quote characters may need escaping for a particular output syntax.

remove-line-numbers.how: Removes numeric prefixes from lines of text.
remove-line-numbers.tryThis: Paste a numbered list copied from a document and review the cleaned result.
remove-line-numbers.watch: Confirm that legitimate numbers at the start of a line are not deleted.

extract-emails-from-text.how: Finds email-like strings embedded in larger text.
extract-emails-from-text.tryThis: Paste a short paragraph with multiple addresses and inspect extracted results.
extract-emails-from-text.watch: Pattern extraction is not proof that an address exists or accepts messages.

extract-urls-from-text.how: Finds URL-like strings inside pasted content.
extract-urls-from-text.tryThis: Paste a paragraph containing multiple web links.
extract-urls-from-text.watch: A string that looks like a URL may still be unsafe or unavailable.

regex-tester.how: Tests a regular expression against sample text and shows matched substrings.
regex-tester.tryThis: Try a simple digit-matching pattern and compare global matches.
regex-tester.watch: Complex expressions can use significant CPU; avoid untrusted high-cost patterns.

utm-url-generator.how: Adds campaign tracking parameters to a destination URL.
utm-url-generator.tryThis: Build a tagged URL for a sample campaign and inspect its query string.
utm-url-generator.watch: Do not place personal identifiers or secrets in marketing URL parameters.

markdown-table-generator.how: Builds Markdown tables from input rows with header and alignment options.
markdown-table-generator.tryThis: Create a two-column table and inspect its separator row.
markdown-table-generator.watch: Pipe characters inside cells need escaping to preserve the table structure.

word-frequency-counter.how: Counts repeated words and summarizes their relative frequency.
word-frequency-counter.tryThis: Paste a short paragraph containing repeated terms and inspect the count order.
word-frequency-counter.watch: Case and punctuation normalization affect the totals.

programming-case-converter.how: Converts identifiers among camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case and kebab-case.
programming-case-converter.tryThis: Enter a multiword phrase and compare naming styles.
programming-case-converter.watch: Acronyms and existing separators may need review when transforming code identifiers.

morse-code-translator.how: Encodes plain characters into Morse code or decodes supported sequences.
morse-code-translator.tryThis: Translate a short alphabetic word and then reverse the conversion.
morse-code-translator.watch: Unsupported symbols and ambiguous spacing need review.

binary-code-translator.how: Encodes or decodes text as binary values.
binary-code-translator.tryThis: Try a short ASCII word and examine its encoded bytes.
binary-code-translator.watch: Unicode characters can occupy several UTF-8 bytes.

number-sorter.how: Sorts a list of numeric values in ascending or descending order.
number-sorter.tryThis: Enter 10, 2 and 5 to check numeric rather than alphabetic ordering.
number-sorter.watch: Invalid numeric entries should be corrected rather than assumed to be zero.

remove-line-breaks.how: Joins multiline text by replacing line boundaries with spaces.
remove-line-breaks.tryThis: Paste an address copied over several lines and inspect the single-line form.
remove-line-breaks.watch: Removing boundaries may change meaning in structured or poetic text.

random-choice-generator.how: Chooses entries from a supplied list according to selection settings.
random-choice-generator.tryThis: Enter several names and generate a random selection.
random-choice-generator.watch: Avoid using casual random picks as an audited lottery or security-sensitive decision.

random-text-generator.how: Generates placeholder words, sentences and paragraphs for layout testing.
random-text-generator.tryThis: Choose a paragraph count and fill a test layout with sample content.
random-text-generator.watch: Generated filler is not verified factual content and should not be published as-is.

markdown-live-preview.how: Renders Markdown while you edit and offers source and HTML export options.
markdown-live-preview.tryThis: Paste a heading and task list, then compare source with the live preview.
markdown-live-preview.watch: Local draft saving is opt-in; rendered HTML should be treated as untrusted when sharing.

markdown-to-html.how: Converts supported Markdown syntax into HTML markup for reuse.
markdown-to-html.tryThis: Try a heading, list and a short link, then inspect generated HTML.
markdown-to-html.watch: Review or sanitize HTML before inserting it into an untrusted destination.

html-to-markdown.how: Converts common HTML elements into a Markdown approximation.
html-to-markdown.tryThis: Paste a document snippet with headings and links.
html-to-markdown.watch: Not every HTML element has a lossless Markdown equivalent.

markdown-to-plain-text.how: Strips Markdown formatting while keeping readable text content.
markdown-to-plain-text.tryThis: Paste formatted Markdown and compare the plain text output.
markdown-to-plain-text.watch: Link destinations and layout details may be lost when formatting is removed.
